basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old accounting major currently living in Portland, Oregon. I recently switched my major to Accounting and am enthusiastic about entering the field. My hobbies include playing Pokémon GO, exploring different types of psychotherapy, and working on automotive projects, particularly with my Jetta GLI. I spend most of my online hours in the evenings, usually between 7 PM and midnight. I'm currently working part-time at a local café while finishing my degree. In a relationship for the past three years.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in accounting is primarily from my academic pursuits, with additional insights from online courses and community college workshops. I’m actively seeking practical experience through internships and volunteering opportunities to enhance my understanding.
